title: Shared Claude and Codex world editing
summary: Published the refined 77-building Blender world, 24 animated residents, idea nameplates and subtitles, plus a Claude collaboration guide, public contribution rules, issue template and pull-request review path. Claude and Codex can edit the same public codebase through normal GitHub branches and attributed footprints; private conversation history remains outside the public repository.

work.evidence: CLAUDE.md; AGENTS.md; src/inhabitants.ts; src/idea-labels.ts; assets/blender/karmic-ideas.blend; npm run build passed; 26 public tests passed; privacy audit passed
